title: Chiral Perturbation Theory: Introduction and Recent Results in the One-Nucleon Sector
note: PDF library/arxiv-0908.3425v1/ — arXiv:0908.3425v1 [hep-ph], stamped 24 Aug 2009; dated 10 April 2009 on page 1. An 85-page pedagogical review, and the cleanest extracted text in this tranche. For the chiral-limit question: the lowest-order Goldstone masses are eqs. (105)-(107) on p. 26; the sentence naming them 'the Gell-Mann, Oakes, and Renner relations', together with B_0 = -<qq>_0/(3 F_0^2) at eq. (103), is on p. 27; the O(q^4) masses with their chiral logarithms are eqs. (162)-(164), pp. 44-45. Registered from library intake.
